hints.mode: INITIATOR connects to a counterparty. ACCEPTOR listens for incoming FIX connections.
hints.fixVersion: FIX protocol version. FIX 4.4 most common. FIXT.1.1 (FIX 5.0 SP2) requires DefaultApplVerID.
hints.senderCompID: Your CompID — identifies this side of the FIX session (tag 49).
hints.targetCompID: Counterparty CompID — identifies the remote side (tag 56).
hints.host: IP or hostname of the ACCEPTOR. Only relevant for INITIATOR mode.
hints.port: TCP port. ACCEPTOR listens; INITIATOR connects to it.
hints.heartbeat: Seconds between heartbeat messages (FIX tag 108). Standard is 30.

descriptions.RETRY: Re-execute a subgraph up to N times; stops on first success.
descriptions.LOOP: Execute a subgraph exactly N times; all iterations must succeed.
descriptions.WAIT: Block until timeout; configurable on-timeout action (proceed / fail / jump).
descriptions.DELAY: Fixed sleep (ms). Always continues on success — no branching.
descriptions.CALL_SCENARIO: Execute another scenario as a reusable synchronous sub-flow.

sendFix.pasteDesc: Paste a raw FIX message (SOH or pipe-separated). Tags 8/9/10/34/49/56 skipped — managed by engine.

expectFix.desc: Waits for an inbound FIX message matching the criteria. Stores matched fields for downstream VALIDATE nodes or cross-node references.
expectFix.correlationDesc: Optional. Use to match a reply back to a specific sent order — e.g. match ClOrdID (tag 11) in the reply against tag 11 sent in the order node.

decision.desc: Evaluates a condition expression. True → success path (onSuccess). False → failure path (onFailure).

validate.desc: Validates fields of a stored message (from an Expect FIX node). Rules run in order; all must pass unless Strict Mode is disabled.

routeFix.desc: Waits for an inbound FIX message and routes to the first rule whose matchers all match. Rules are evaluated top-to-bottom. A rule with no matchers acts as default/fallback.
routeFix.noRules: No rules yet. Add rules to route incoming FIX messages.

retry.desc: Re-executes the target node up to N times. Stops as soon as one attempt succeeds. Use for transient failures (e.g. network flaps).

wait.desc: Blocks execution for a configurable duration. On timeout: proceed to next node, fail, or jump to another node.

loop.desc: Executes the target node exactly N times. All iterations must succeed — fails immediately on the first failure.

delay.desc: Fixed sleep in milliseconds. Always continues on the success path — no timeout actions or branching.

httpRequest.noBody: GET requests have no body — use query params in the URL (e.g. ?key=value)
